annotations.title: A player's or team's verified figures

description: The verified figures Muffed holds for one NFL player or one NFL team (by name or abbreviation, e.g. "Bijan Robinson" or "DEN"), with the source's rank where one exists. By default the headline figures for that player or team; scope "all" returns every figure held, and a named metric returns all of that metric's rows. Names are resolved against the players and teams Muffed holds; an unrecognised name returns the closest matches rather than a guess.
name: get_entity_metrics
